citations.assessment: Compiler conjectures a scribal error. The Bavli version identifies Ammi, Assi, Yehoshua ben Levi and the Caesarea rabbis as guests, and has son of a lion where Heilprin transmits son of Torah.
The checked Yoma witness presents the name Yose beRabbi Chanina in brackets beside Zeora bar Chama in the teaching about washing.

citations.assessment: Adler’s itinerary distinguishes four synagogues at Hillah. It explicitly places Meir’s and Mar Keshisha’s graves in front of their synagogues and names the synagogues of Zeiri son of Chama and Mari. It does not attribute graves to the latter two in this passage or call this Meir the academy head.

notes.text: Yoma in the Bavli reads Son of a lion. The two Yerushalmi passages give different forms of Yose’s patronymic. The Hillah account names the synagogues of both Zeiri son of Chama and Mari and explicitly describes Meir’s and Mar Keshisha’s burial. The compiler’s edition, source spelling Mila and burial tradition remain to be collated.
